home.heroTitle:
Move the world,
one shipment at a time.
home.heroSubtitle: Priority Mail Express is your enterprise courier partner for international express delivery, secure tracking, and QR-verified receipts.
home.trackBoxSubtitle: Enter your tracking number to see live shipment movement.
home.featuresSubtitle: Built for couriers, branches, and customers — every shipment is registered, tracked, and verified end-to-end.

international.title: International Delivery
international.desc: Door-to-door coverage across 200+ countries with regional sortation hubs.

express.title: Express Courier Service
express.desc: Time-definite next-day, 2-day, and same-week express options worldwide.

secure.title: Secure Shipment Tracking
secure.desc: End-to-end visibility from registration to delivery with audit-grade events.

qr.title: QR Code Receipt Tracking
qr.desc: Every receipt embeds a unique QR linking customers straight to live tracking.

pod.title: Proof of Delivery
pod.desc: Receiver signature, photo, GPS, and timestamped delivery confirmation.

support.title: Customer Support
support.desc: 24/7 multilingual support team for senders, receivers, and enterprise clients.

track.title: Track your shipment
track.subtitle: Enter your tracking number or scan the QR on your receipt.
track.notFoundMessage: We could not locate a shipment with the tracking number entered.

verify.title: Verify a receipt
verify.subtitle: Enter the receipt number and the 6-character verification code printed on your PME receipt.

footer.tagline: Priority Mail Express delivers fast, secure international courier and logistics services with end-to-end QR-verified tracking for every shipment.

install.title: Download the PME app
install.subtitle: Install Priority Mail Express for faster tracking and one-tap access.
